text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Stripe.

I’d be a strong fit for your 10-day backend-focused MERN project. I can help complete the Node.js backend, support API work, and guide the team to finish the integration cleanly.

One recent project I built was a Streaming chat widget for Quillstack in edtech. I built the React frontend and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token, with first token on screen in about 600 ms and support for 30k chats a month.

I’m comfortable moving quickly, keeping the backend organized, and collaborating closely with your team to ship on time.
